d:
Abdul Gafoor was the Chief Minister of Bihar when JP movement erupted (a mass student movement, that led to dethroned Indira Gandi's government in 1977) had become violent during Gafoor tenure. Even Jayprakash Narayan was manhandled by Bihar police in this movement. Later, he elected for Lok Sabha thrice and once (under Rajiv Gandhi) appointed union minister for Urban Development. Watch this latest episode of The Lallantop's special political series named Mukhyamantri by Editor Saurabh Dwivedi for more details.
